summary: Mayan EDMS is an electronic document management system designed to organise digital files. It provides features such as document previews, optical character recognition, and automated categorisation.
goodFor: It suits teams or individuals who need a centralised, self-hosted repository to process, index, and search through large volumes of digital documents.
watchOut: The absence of recent tagged releases and commit activity suggests you should carefully evaluate its long-term maintenance status and community support before committing production data to it.
deployNotes: As a containerised application built for Docker and Kubernetes, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for file storage and set up an external database alongside a reverse proxy.
